content.short: SIXR Cricket is a fantasy sports and NFT gaming platform on TON dedicated to cricket enthusiasts.
content.description: SIXR Cricket is an immersive fantasy sports and NFT gaming platform built on the TON blockchain, specifically designed for the global audience of cricket fans. It allows users to collect player NFTs, build their dream teams, and compete in various tournaments to earn rewards based on real-world match performances. By combining the passion for fantasy sports with the benefits of digital asset ownership, SIXR Cricket provides a rewarding and engaging experience for its community. It leverages the speed of TON to ensure transparent and efficient prize distribution for cricket enthusiasts worldwide.
content.meta: Build your dream cricket team and earn on SIXR. Immersive sports NFTs on TON via Lancers Web3 Explorer.
